description: Read the latest (or a specific) response-streaming run's whole-run state and response-queue progress. Only completed means downstream analysis has finished
name: get_response_streaming_status

finish_reason.description: Why a "failed" or "cancelled" run ended: credits_exhausted (no credits remaining), credits_paused (credit allocation paused by the partner), subscription_inactive, organization_deleted, entitlement_unreadable (billing could not be read; pending responses are retried by the backfill), cancelled_by_user, responses_failed (collection finished with failed responses), items_stuck, attribute_extraction_failed, workflow_error, stale. Null while running, for completed runs, and for runs older than this field.

progress.description: Response-queue completion only. These counts and percentage do not indicate downstream analysis readiness.

percentage.description: Percentage of response-queue items completed or failed. A value of 100 does not indicate downstream analysis readiness.

completed_count_observed_at.description: Observation time of the cached retained-response count. Null or absent means unmeasured; completedCount is not a measured zero. Reads never refresh counts.

initial_completed_count_observed_at.description: Observation time of the snapshot frozen at the first terminal transition; it can precede initialTerminalAt. Null means unmeasured.

saved_response_progress.description: Cached retained-response counts, separate from execution-queue progress. A missing completed_count_observed_at means the count is unmeasured, not zero. Initial fields preserve the last observed snapshot at first terminal transition, including its observation time.

state.description: Whole-run state. Only "completed" means response collection and downstream analysis have finished; "running" can coexist with 100 percent response progress.
